name: Kyoto Driving Park – Yamagiwa + Miyabi
layoutOrigin: Hybrid of Yamagiwa main course and Miyabi short course

regions.title: Start/Finish
regions.cornerType: timing line on inner upper straight
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Cross the line on the inner upper straight, then prepare immediately for the braking phase into the right-hand bulb.
regions.racecraftNote: Start-line overlap matters because the first braking reference arrives on the same inner straight before Turn 1.
regions.uiNote: Show lap timing, start procedure notes, and pit-wall race control context.

regions.title: Sector 1
regions.elevation: Opening section trends across the high Yamagiwa-style ridge before dropping toward the connector.
regions.drivingNote: Prioritize minimum steering and early throttle through the upper sequence.
regions.racecraftNote: Side-by-side racing is possible only if both cars commit before the downhill approach.
regions.uiNote: Use this selection to summarize opening pace, split loss, and early-lap risk.

regions.title: Sector 2
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; the route compresses and rotates through the connector.
regions.drivingNote: Sacrifice entry speed where needed so the lower loop can be straightened on exit.
regions.racecraftNote: This sector is incident-prone because cars arrive from different slip angles and closing speeds.
regions.uiNote: Show connector warnings, rotation notes, and mid-lap consistency data.

regions.title: Sector 3
regions.elevation: Lower Miyabi-style loop returns toward the inner straight and final upper complex.
regions.drivingNote: Build exit speed first, then place the car cleanly for the long inner run.
regions.racecraftNote: Defensive lines here can compromise the final straight and invite a late move.
regions.uiNote: Use this selection to compare lower-loop exits and final-sector attack opportunities.

regions.title: Turn 1
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; entry appears near the upper ridge.
regions.drivingNote: Brake on the inner straight and rotate into the right-hand bulb without running wide.
regions.racecraftNote: Opening-lap overlap is decided before turn-in because the braking zone is short and direct.
regions.uiNote: Highlight as the first braking and rotation point after the timing line.

regions.title: Turn 2
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; still on the upper section.
regions.drivingNote: Finish the opening bulb and release the car onto the outer top run.
regions.racecraftNote: A driver defending too tightly at Turn 1 loses the exit that carries through Turn 2.
regions.uiNote: Show paired T1/T2 rhythm guidance with Turn 2 as the exit/return marker.

regions.title: Turn 3
regions.elevation: High-point behavior inferred from the minimap and POV climb cue.
regions.drivingNote: Keep steering inputs small; the car should breathe across the crest rather than be forced.
regions.racecraftNote: Dirty air can make the car drift wide if the entry is rushed.
regions.uiNote: Mark as a stability and confidence corner.

regions.title: Turn 4
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Aim for a clean lift and early unwind to preserve speed toward the left-side drop.
regions.racecraftNote: The following run rewards the driver who exits with the steering straight first.
regions.uiNote: Pair this with T3 as the upper S-section.

regions.title: Turn 5
regions.elevation: The line begins to fall away toward the outside of the Yamagiwa-style section.
regions.drivingNote: Carry speed but keep a margin for the downhill braking reference that follows.
regions.racecraftNote: A wide exit can open the door into the next braking zone.
regions.uiNote: Show as the final high-speed corner before the descent.

regions.title: Turn 6
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; downhill transition begins here.
regions.drivingNote: Brake in a straight line and avoid carrying too much speed to the outside curb.
regions.racecraftNote: This is a pressure point for late lunges after a strong upper-sector run.
regions.uiNote: Use as a braking-confidence region.

regions.title: Turn 7
regions.elevation: The car continues dropping toward the technical middle section.
regions.drivingNote: Let the car run without scrubbing speed; the next braking zone is more important.
regions.racecraftNote: Following cars can close quickly if the lead car over-slows the connector.
regions.uiNote: Show as a flow corner, not a primary overtaking point.

regions.title: Turn 8
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; transition load builds on approach.
regions.drivingNote: Prepare for the chicane by straightening the car before final brake pressure.
regions.racecraftNote: A driver who misses the brake marker here blocks the connector exit.
regions.uiNote: Mark as the Sector 1 braking handoff.

regions.title: Turn 9
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; compression point before the lower loop.
regions.drivingNote: Trail brake gently and keep the first apex tidy so the quick change is available.
regions.racecraftNote: Over-rotation here creates a chain reaction into T10.
regions.uiNote: Show connector entry stability notes.

regions.title: Turn 10
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; low-speed balance region.
regions.drivingNote: Prioritize rotation and avoid taking curb that unsettles the car.
regions.racecraftNote: Side-by-side overlap should usually be yielded before the lower loop entry.
regions.uiNote: Use as the first technical-detail drill-down.

regions.title: Turn 11
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; lower Miyabi-style portion.
regions.drivingNote: Get the car rotated early and prepare for a patient throttle pickup.
regions.racecraftNote: The inside line is defensive but costly for the run through T12.
regions.uiNote: Show lower-loop entry and rotation notes.

regions.title: Turn 12
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Use the road width without opening the steering too slowly.
regions.racecraftNote: A small exit mistake here carries into the lower hairpin setup.
regions.uiNote: Highlight as a setup corner.

regions.title: Turn 13
regions.elevation: Low-point behavior inferred from the map and POV; exact profile pending telemetry.
regions.drivingNote: Brake square, rotate late, and prioritize the longest possible exit.
regions.racecraftNote: This is the strongest passing zone in the lower loop if overlap is established early.
regions.uiNote: Show as a major braking and overtaking marker.

regions.title: Turn 14
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; the car begins climbing back toward the inner connector.
regions.drivingNote: Avoid wheelspin and open the exit to start building speed.
regions.racecraftNote: A poor launch here exposes the driver through the next acceleration zone.
regions.uiNote: Pair with speed-zone-2 for exit analysis.

regions.title: Turn 15
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; return path transitions back toward the upper course.
regions.drivingNote: Let the car breathe at apex and keep a clean exit to the right-side sweep.
regions.racecraftNote: The best attack is usually a better exit rather than a late dive.
regions.uiNote: Show as the transition from lower loop to return complex.

regions.title: Turn 16
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; line loads laterally as it climbs.
regions.drivingNote: Commit early and do not over-correct mid-corner.
regions.racecraftNote: Dirty air and tire wear show up here as mid-corner understeer.
regions.uiNote: Use as a high-speed stability marker.

regions.title: Turn 17
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Clip the late apex and avoid drifting beyond the exit curb.
regions.racecraftNote: A driver can defend here but risks losing the final straight.
regions.uiNote: Show as the final outside hook before the upper return.

regions.title: Turn 18
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; short load change on the inner return.
regions.drivingNote: Straighten the car quickly and focus on exit speed through the inner straight.
regions.racecraftNote: Mistakes here create a run for the timing line rather than an immediate pass.
regions.uiNote: Show final-sector flow and speed preservation.

regions.title: Turn 19
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; final climb toward the main straight.
regions.drivingNote: Release the brake early and place the car for full throttle back to the line.
regions.racecraftNote: The exit decides whether an attack is available into the next lap.
regions.uiNote: Show as the final exit and lap-completion region.

regions.title: Braking Zone 1
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; upper straight braking load.
regions.drivingNote: Brake on the inner upper straight after the timing line and before the right-hand bulb.
regions.racecraftNote: Opening-lap incidents are likely if the inside car cannot slow before the Turn 1 rotation point.
regions.uiNote: Display braking reference, brake pressure notes, and incident-risk warning.

regions.title: Braking Zone 2
regions.elevation: Dropping approach inferred from the Yamagiwa-style descent.
regions.drivingNote: Brake earlier than the visual speed suggests; the car is loaded and pointed downhill.
regions.racecraftNote: Common overshoot location when following closely.
regions.uiNote: Show as a major braking risk and Sector 1 handoff.

regions.title: Braking Zone 3
regions.elevation: Low-loop braking reference inferred from the track map.
regions.drivingNote: Brake straight and hold enough rotation for a clean T13 exit.
regions.racecraftNote: Primary lower-loop passing point.
regions.uiNote: Display alongside Turn 13 as the main overtaking region.

regions.title: Braking Zone 4
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Trim speed just enough to keep the car inside at T17.
regions.racecraftNote: Defensive braking can trigger exit-speed loss.
regions.uiNote: Show as a secondary braking zone.

regions.title: Braking Zone 5
regions.cornerType: technical lift before the inner return
regions.elevation: Final climb/transition inferred from POV and minimap position.
regions.drivingNote: Use this only as a light trim before the inner return; the main braking reference is Braking Zone 1.
regions.racecraftNote: Small mistakes here affect the setup onto the line rather than creating a primary passing zone.
regions.uiNote: Show as a secondary trim reference, not a heavy braking marker.

regions.title: Upper Ridge
regions.elevation: Highest visual portion inferred from the POV minimap and uphill cue.
regions.drivingNote: Keep the car settled as load lightens near the crest.
regions.racecraftNote: A following car may wash wide in dirty air.
regions.uiNote: Show high-point note and future telemetry placeholder.

regions.title: Downhill Connector
regions.elevation: Relative descent inferred from Yamagiwa-style upper-to-middle flow.
regions.drivingNote: Expect speed to build while braking stability decreases.
regions.racecraftNote: The closing-rate difference can produce rear-end contact.
regions.uiNote: Display descent warning and braking-zone pairing.

regions.title: Lower Compression
regions.elevation: Low point inferred; replace with exact elevation map if available.
regions.drivingNote: Use the compression to rotate without overloading the rear.
regions.racecraftNote: Cars with different tire states diverge strongly here.
regions.uiNote: Show grip and traction note.

regions.title: Hairpin Exit Rise
regions.elevation: Return climb inferred from lower-loop exit behavior.
regions.drivingNote: Throttle application matters more than minimum speed.
regions.racecraftNote: A better launch can set up the next-sector attack.
regions.uiNote: Pair with speed-zone-2.

regions.title: Outer Return Load
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Avoid sharp steering corrections as lateral load builds.
regions.racecraftNote: Understeer here creates a defensive vulnerability at corner exit.
regions.uiNote: Show stability and tire-load context.

regions.title: Upper Acceleration Zone
regions.elevation: Upper ridge acceleration inferred from the minimap reference.
regions.drivingNote: Keep steering shallow and let the car accelerate across the top.
regions.racecraftNote: Draft and exit speed can set up the first braking zone.
regions.uiNote: Display speed-building and slipstream notes.

regions.title: Lower Loop Launch
regions.elevation: Climb away from the lower loop inferred from reference.
regions.drivingNote: Be patient on throttle until the steering opens.
regions.racecraftNote: Exit traction decides whether an overtake is possible in Sector 3.
regions.uiNote: Display launch quality and traction notes.

regions.title: Inner Straight Run
regions.elevation: Relative elevation inferred from POV; replace with telemetry if available.
regions.drivingNote: Straighten the car and commit to full throttle toward the final complex.
regions.racecraftNote: This run exposes any compromise from T18/T19 setup.
regions.uiNote: Show final-sector acceleration and closing-rate context.
